title: run_manifest.json
description: FROZEN CONTRACT v0. Not in the PDF - added 2026-08-20 because the prototype needs a single artefact describing a run, and inventing it under pressure in Phase 5 is exactly the late-integration failure S10 rates Severe. This is the only file the frontend must understand in order to render every view.

config_hash.description: SHA-256 of config.yaml. Two runs with the same seed and config_hash must produce identical numbers.

is_fixture.description: True for committed fixture data. The prototype renders a visible FIXTURE badge when set, so no screenshot of fake numbers can be mistaken for a result.

artefacts.description: Relative paths from the artefacts root.

demo_slice.description: 25-50k row slice the UI actually loads (NOTES.md D-003).

baseline.description: NOTES.md D-002. Every headline number is reported as lift over this. Defined here so the baseline can never be quietly weakened to inflate the lift.

features.description: Transaction-level only. Session and graph features are excluded by definition.

metrics_unseen.description: Held-out families and unseen compositions. S6.4: never merged with seen.

ablation.description: Per-level and per-signal contribution. S6.1 requires the lift each level contributes; D-004 requires the behavioural signal's contribution to be a stated number.

detection_rate.description: Headline for the Loop Helix: fraction of fraudulent instances caught at the operating threshold.

n_chains_rejected.description: S7.2 says the rejection rate is itself an interesting number.

prevalence.description: S5.2: stated next to every metric, without exception.

auc_pr.description: The honest headline at low prevalence.

alert_rate.description: Fraction of all transactions flagged. Determines review staffing.

lift_over_baseline.description: Percentage improvement over run_manifest.baseline, per metric. Null on the baseline row itself.

fidelity.description: S5.3. NOTES.md D-005: the discriminator runs only on columns the reference dataset also has.

discriminator_auc.description: Approaching 0.5 means indistinguishable. Null until a reference profile exists to discriminate against - stated as null rather than filled with a number that measured something else.

excluded_columns.description: Columns with no reference analogue - the behavioural telemetry. Calibrated against published effect sizes, not against a dataset. Surfaced in the UI as such.

correlation_delta_frobenius.description: S5.3: joint structure is where naive generators fail, so this matters more than any per-column statistic.
